answer: The mesa of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the tundra of a task receipt, and the echo is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing.
